relationships.subject: CCG-1423
relationships.evidence_quote: CCG-1423, a RhoA/MRTF-A pathway inhibitor, reversed strain-induced fibrosis.

relationships.subject: RhoA/MRTF-A signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Additional experiments showed that RhoA, ROCK2, MRTF-A, SRF, MMP-12, and CTGF were upregulated; however, aggrecan and collagen II were downregulated in NPCs under overload strain.

key_findings: Overload strain activates RhoA/MRTF-A and upregulates MMP-12 and CTGF in NPCs
